request: Investigate why order ORD-1003 is delayed.

steps.text: I will pull the order details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, warehouse, and line items.
Since the order is marked SHIPPED and is past the promised date, I will check the shipment tracking to see status, ETA, and any recorded delay reasons.

shipments.recorded_delay_reason: Carrier reported hub closure at Toledo, OH due to winter storm

events.description: Hub closed due to winter storm; revised ETA 2026-03-18

steps.text: I will submit the investigation report with the findings, evidence, cause, and recommended actions.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1003 is delayed due to a carrier-reported hub closure at Toledo, OH from a winter storm; the shipment has since departed the hub and the carrier’s revised ETA is 2026-03-18. The warehouse dispatched on the ship-by date, so the delay is not warehouse-related.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1003 fulfillment_status SHIPPED from WH-CHI, ship_by_date 2026-03-04, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-09 (is_past_promised_date true).
get_shipment_status: SHP-5003 via Great Lakes Freight tracking GLF-88231 status DELAYED, recorded_delay_reason "Carrier reported hub closure at Toledo, OH due to winter storm".
arguments.likely_cause: Great Lakes Freight hub closure at Toledo, OH due to a winter storm, as recorded by the carrier.
uncertainties: Whether the shipment will meet the revised ETA of 2026-03-18.
No tracking movement posted since 2026-03-12; potential for additional carrier transit delays.

recommended_actions.details: Inform Contoso Hardware that shipment SHP-5003 (GLF-88231) is delayed due to a carrier hub closure at Toledo, OH, with a revised ETA of 2026-03-18; cite get_shipment_status showing status DELAYED and recorded_delay_reason plus the updated ETA.

Continue monitoring tracking for SHP-5003; if no new scan by 2026-03-17 or if not delivered by the revised ETA 2026-03-18, be prepared to contact Great Lakes Freight for a trace. Justification: get_shipment_status shows last_event_date 2026-03-12 (days_since_last_event 4) and current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-18.

arguments.recommendation: Notify the customer of the carrier delay and revised ETA, and continue to monitor tracking closely through 2026-03-18 before escalating to the carrier if movement or delivery does not occur.
